title: 11 Things HR won't tell you that could ruin your career
description:
HR has a playbook. And you're not in it.

After years inside corporate HR, I'm breaking the silence on the 11 things your HR department will never voluntarily tell you ...because knowing them could literally save your career. 

The system isn't built to protect you. But this video is.

If you want the full playbook — not just the highlights — my book Clock In breaks down every HR secret, corporate mind game, and career survival strategy I learned the hard way, all in one place. It's the no-BS career advice I wish someone had handed me on day one.

 Get Clock In here: https://emilydurham.org/clock-in
